purpose: Known-truth waveform benchmark, not a universal method ranking
generator: Poisson events 0.05/s; exponential calcium decay 1.2s; common loading core .9 / peripheral .25; independent loading .45 / .95; additive Gaussian SD .15; delayed common component uniform -3 to +3s; identical events and noise within each paired scenario
signal_input: Synthetic dF/F-like traces, no extra demeaning or temporal smoothing
comparators: Maintainer defaults; BE thresholded common matrix; Rombach x>=.5; strength top20
selection: No parameter or seed selection on these outcomes; both timing scenarios retained
statistics: Friedman within paired networks; exact two-sided signed rank; BH across all pairs and both timing conditions for each comparison family
development: Original pilot seeds 0-19 retained, now development only; 21 configurations per definition selected on mean F1 over both scenarios
tie_break: Highest average F1, then smallest absolute offset, then tau closest to .20
test_selection: No revisiting grid or generator after new-test results
